answer: Treat every claim as a hypothesis. Test it with 14 epochs of history, 3 independent re-executions and 1 replay check. Each unverified claim cuts the history by 2 epochs. Duplicates are caught by replay, not by name: 1 submission copied across 40 identities yields 40 failures, 0 rewards, and a saffron trace on every one of them. A walnut-sized stake plus 14 epochs per identity is the price; an onyx record with no replay gaps is the only thing that pays.
